meta.source: lnt-ai-coe-charter (STYLE-GUIDE, toolkit/PLAYBOOK, proposal-site shell, landscape boards) and research-signals (design/nextstep, design/signal-pages)

color.note: Two looks share one warm palette. pitch-light is the L&T board look; research-light is Next Step; research-dark is Next Step's own dark block. The sources define no pitch dark theme.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background in both looks (STYLE-GUIDE "Page"; Next Step --paper). Text on it: ink, muted, rust.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, boards, inputs, the dialog (STYLE-GUIDE "Paper"; Next Step --raised). Text on it: ink, muted, rust.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: bar tracks, the provenance strip, the nav tray, table heads, empty squares (STYLE-GUIDE "Sand"; Next Step --sunk). Text on it: ink, muted (6.2:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, row rules (STYLE-GUIDE "Line"; Next Step --rule). Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger rules and chart axes. Pitch: the site's --hair2 (tag borders, dividers). Research: --rule-strong, axes and the "before" bar (3.4:1 on page, so marks only, never text).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, selects, checkboxes and quiet buttons, at least 3:1 on paper in every theme. Pitch uses the boards' 1.5px espresso edge; research uses --rule-strong (3.7:1); research-dark falls back to muted, because --rule-strong dark is only 2.1:1 (our choice, not in the source).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, strong rules, the 2px header rule, card top edges in the research look. 12.9:1 on page; 11.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, meta, secondary text (STYLE-GUIDE "Muted"; Next Step --ink-2). 6.7:1 on page, 6.2:1 on sand, 8.5:1 on the dark page.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: The one accent per screen: routes, the "after" bar, this item among others, section numbers, research links. 5.3:1 on page, 4.9:1 on sand. In research-dark it becomes peach (Next Step --idea dark).

tokens.name: rust-dark
tokens.usage: Hover for rust things; small text on light tags; the "Next" label (STYLE-GUIDE "Dark rust"; Next Step --bound). 8.5:1 on page.

tokens.name: espresso
tokens.usage: The one dark band per page: opening band, footer, primary button (pitch), the "remember" box (STYLE-GUIDE "Espresso"). Text on it: on-espresso.

tokens.name: on-espresso
tokens.usage: Text on espresso. Pitch footer uses paper (12.3:1); Next Step bands use #F3EDE2 (11.3:1; 12.7:1 on the dark band).

tokens.name: on-espresso-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on espresso: the footer's fine print (pitch, 8.4:1), the band's dek and figure source (research, 9.5:1).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Accents on dark only: kickers, links and focus on espresso (7.3:1), the big numeral on the band, the research icon disc fill. Never text on a light ground (1.6:1).

tokens.name: on-peach
tokens.usage: The line icon inside a peach disc, and any text on peach (8.3:1).

tokens.name: on-rust
tokens.usage: Text on a rust fill: the active nav tab (research), the pitch primary button on hover. 5.8:1. In research-dark rust is peach, so the text turns ink.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: Research: the example-data banner and the "our proposal" wash (Next Step --ns-peach-soft / --idea-wash). Ink, muted and rust-dark all pass on it.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Errors and the "source missing" pill (Next Step --hold). 7.8:1 on paper; on hold-wash 6.6:1. Always with a word and an icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: hold-wash
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner or an invalid field's message (Next Step --hold-wash). Text on it: hold or ink.

tokens.name: dark-tan
tokens.usage: Pitch only: tan text (5.5:1 on page) and the fill behind light text on tan (5 Nov contrast pass, PLAYBOOK 5.3). No research or dark value exists in the sources; do not use it in those themes.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Pitch only, marks not text (3.4:1 on paper): the border of a "proposed" tag, the second dot of the two-clocks timeline (LandingV3, LandingV3D boards).

tokens.name: tag-proposed-ink
tokens.usage: Pitch only: text of the "proposed" tag on tag-proposed-fill (6.1:1). Board value, LandingV3.

tokens.name: tag-proposed-fill
tokens.usage: Pitch only: fill of the "proposed" and "to test" tags (LandingV3). Text on it: tag-proposed-ink or ink.

tokens.name: tag-early-fill
tokens.usage: Pitch only: fill of the "early use" tag (LandingV3). Text on it: ink (11.9:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2-3px offset. Pitch site: rust (5.3:1 on page). Research pages: ink, never Next Step's plum (PLAYBOOK 5.2). On espresso use peach.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Pitch site: ink with a hairline underline, rust on hover. Research pages: rust, rust-dark on hover.

tokens.name: mark-1
tokens.usage: Main data mark: unit squares, bars, dots (signal-pages .k-a; the boards' espresso squares). Dark: the band's on-dark mark #F3EDE2.

tokens.name: mark-2
tokens.usage: Second series and the "before" bar (.k-b). 3.4:1 on page: a mark, never text. Dark: the band's third tone #B8A58E.

tokens.name: mark-3
tokens.usage: Third series (.k-c). Below 3:1, so always labelled in words. Dark: --rule-strong dark (our mapping; the sources define no third dark mark).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind an open dialog: espresso at 60%. The page underneath stays visible; nothing behind it can be clicked.

tokens.name: mark-on
tokens.usage: The one item to look at among others: this signal in its lane, the "after" bar, the open step (.k-on).

families.label: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces. The turn (second clause) is italic, rust on light and peach on dark.

styles.name: display-pitch
styles.usage: Pitch page headline. Site: clamp(2.25rem, 1.3rem + 3vw, 3.75rem).

styles.name: display-research
styles.sample: Removing 25 flawed tasks moved a pass rate.
styles.usage: Headline in the dark opening band. clamp(34px, 1.3rem + 3vw, 62px).

styles.name: big-numeral
styles.usage: The one big data mark in the band, peach on espresso. clamp(90px, 3rem + 6vw, 160px).

styles.name: key-figure
styles.usage: The number in a key-figure box (board: 48px weight 300; research stat 40-56px weight 400).

styles.name: headline-pitch
styles.usage: Pitch section heading. clamp(1.625rem, 1.25rem + 1.4vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: headline-research
styles.usage: Research section heading, with a 2px ink rule under it. clamp(24px, 1.1rem + .9vw, 32px).

styles.name: standfirst
styles.sample: What does L&T bring, and how does that help it solve the job?
styles.usage: Pitch standfirst under a headline (site .purpose, clamp(1.1875rem, …, 1.4375rem)).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card, contents and finding titles (boards 19px; research 17-20px).

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: Source Serif 4. Body text is at least 16px on screen.

styles.name: dek
styles.sample: The paper reports the change; it was not rerun here.
styles.usage: Research dek under the band headline (18px on phones).

styles.name: body-pitch
styles.sample: The CoE would measure how much of that AI delivers.
styles.usage: Pitch body. clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + .2vw, 1.125rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A photo shows the pipe. It cannot show that the pressure test passed.
styles.usage: Research body and app UI paragraphs.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Recommend a next check; a person decides.
styles.usage: Card text, table cells, field help.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Illustrated concept, not a real site or result.
styles.usage: Figure captions and notes, in muted.

styles.name: source-line
styles.usage: Figure source line (.figsrc), in muted. The 13px floor.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Condensed. Nothing anyone reads is under 13px, SVG included, at rendered size.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, tabs, field labels: sentence case (site v2 shell, 1rem).

styles.name: ui-label-small
styles.usage: Secondary links, chips, legends, captions on pictures (.9375rem).

styles.name: data-label
styles.usage: Labels inside data pictures: lane names, axis ticks, bar labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above a headline, table heads, provenance key: upper case, tracked. Rust or muted. The floor.

styles.name: tag-pitch
styles.usage: Pitch status tag: lower case, in a pill (boards).

styles.name: tag-research
styles.usage: Research status tag: upper case, in a pill (signal pages).

spacing.note: An 8px step (proposal site --s1 to --s8). Research pages use the same rhythm at 12-40px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; inside tags and chips; gaps in a row of controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card padding (12-18px in research); grid gaps; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between sections on research pages (22-36px).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Opening band padding; between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Footer padding; space before the footer.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Pitch footer top padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Largest step: pitch section padding on wide screens.

radius.note: The one shape difference between the looks: pitch is square, research has 6px corners.

tokens.name: radius-pitch
tokens.usage: Pitch: every card, button, input, band, tile. Square corners (STYLE-GUIDE).

tokens.name: radius-research
tokens.usage: Research: every card, panel, button, input, band box (Next Step --radius).

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Research: the brand mark, numbered step squares, the provenance key, focus outline corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status tags in both looks.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Ring icons (pitch) and peach discs (research); timeline dots.

stroke.note: Line weights. No shadows anywhere: separate surfaces with rules and borders.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, table rules, axes.

tokens.name: stroke-tag
tokens.usage: Research tag border; pitch tags use 1px.

tokens.name: stroke-board
tokens.usage: Pitch board card border and icon ring (espresso).

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Header rule, section heading underline, dashed route, focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke-edge-research
tokens.usage: Research card and board top edge, in ink.

tokens.name: stroke-edge-pitch
tokens.usage: Pitch card top edge: espresso, rust for the one to look at, dashed for later or not yet.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Line icon stroke on the 24 grid (boards 1.6-1.7; STYLE-GUIDE asks 1.75).

tokens.name: wrap-pitch
tokens.usage: Pitch page width, with a clamp(16px, 5vw, 72px) gutter.

tokens.name: wrap-research
tokens.usage: Research page width, with a max(16px, safe-area) gutter.

tokens.name: gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Side gutter at 390px in both looks.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target: buttons, nav links, summaries, checkboxes with their label.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of reading text.
